# repeat_to_meet_cutoff { #mofography.compute.repeat_to_meet_cutoff }

`compute.repeat_to_meet_cutoff(ase_atoms, forcefield_mixed, cutoff=12.5)`

It takes an ASE atoms object and a forcefield, and returns a new ASE atoms object and a new
forcefield that are repeated in such a way that the vdw cutoff is met

## Parameters

| Name               | Type   | Description                                    | Default    |
|--------------------|--------|------------------------------------------------|------------|
| `ase_atoms`        |        | the atoms object from ASE                      | _required_ |
| `forcefield_mixed` |        | the forcefield parameters for the mixed system | _required_ |
| `cutoff`           |        | the cutoff distance for the forcefield         | `12.5`     |

## Returns

| Type   | Description                                                                                                |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | ase_atoms_repeat is a supercell of ase_atoms, forcefield_mixed_repeat is a tiled array of forcefield_mixed |
